sma.confluence_major_below: 🎯 Major Confluence : Retest of the SMA 200d ({ecart_sma200:+.2f}%) and SMA 50w ({ecart_w50:+.2f}%) supports from below — optimal accumulation zone.
sma.confluence_major_touch: 🎯 Major Confluence : Price touching the SMA 200d ({ecart_sma200:+.2f}%) and SMA 50w ({ecart_w50:+.2f}%) — confirm the direction before acting.
sma.support_mt_below: 📍 Medium-Term Support : Price retesting the SMA 200d from below ({ecart_sma200:+.2f}%) — medium-term accumulation signal.
sma.sma200_above: 📈 SMA 200d : Price slightly above ({ecart_sma200:+.2f}%) — uptrend preserved, less optimal entry.
sma.support_lt_below: 📈 Long-Term Support : Price retesting the SMA 50w from below ({ecart_w50:+.2f}%) — long-term area of interest.
sma.sma50w_above: 📊 SMA 50w : Price slightly above ({ecart_w50:+.2f}%) — support preserved in an uptrend.
sma.deep_discount: 📉 Deep discount : Price below the SMA 200d ({ecart_sma200:+.2f}%) and SMA 50w ({ecart_w50:+.2f}%) — wait for a stabilization signal.
sma.extended_above: 📈 Extended above the averages : Price well above the SMA 200d ({ecart_sma200:+.2f}%) and SMA 50w ({ecart_w50:+.2f}%) — no nearby support, less favorable entry.
trend.bullish_confirmed: 📊 Confirmed Bullish Structure : SMA50d ({sma50_price:.2f}) > SMA200d — rising SMA200 slope ({sma200_slope:+.1f}%/20d). Retest in a supportive context.
trend.favorable: 📊 Favorable Structure : SMA50d above the SMA200d — underlying trend intact.
trend.bearish: ⚠️ Bearish Structure : SMA50d ({sma50_price:.2f}) below SMA200d — falling slope ({sma200_slope:+.1f}%/20d). 'Falling knife' risk — extra caution.
trend.neutral_bearish: ⚠️ Neutral/Bearish Structure : SMA50d below SMA200d (death cross) — negative medium-term momentum.
high52.major_correction: 🔻 Major correction : Down {dist_52w:+.1f}% vs 52-week High — significant recovery potential.
high52.near_highs: ⚠️ Near the highs : Only {dist_52w:+.1f}% from the 52-week High — limited safety margin.
low52.capitulation_zone: 🔵 Potential Capitulation Zone : Price {dist_52w_low:+.1f}% from the 52-week low ({l52w_price:.2f}) — limited residual risk, strong rebound potential.
low52.near_floor: 🔵 Near the yearly floor : {dist_52w_low:+.1f}% above the 52-week low ({l52w_price:.2f}).
div.annual: 💰 Estimated annual dividend : {div_montant:.2f} (last paid on {div_date}), indicative yield ~{rendement_div_pct:.2f}% on the current price.
rsiw.deep_oversold: ⚡ Pronounced Weekly Oversold (RSI W: {rsi_weekly:.1f}) : Major reversal signal to watch.
rsiw.oversold: ⚡ Weekly Oversold (RSI W: {rsi_weekly:.1f}) : Medium-term reversal potential.
rsiw.neutral: 🔄 Weekly RSI in neutral zone ({rsi_weekly:.1f}) : Momentum without excess, trend to be confirmed.
rsid.extreme_oversold: 🔥 Extreme Daily Oversold (RSI D: {rsi_daily:.1f}) : Technical rebound likely in the short term.
rsid.oversold: 🔥 Daily Oversold (RSI D: {rsi_daily:.1f}) : Short-term selling pressure, favorable zone to accumulate.
rsid.neutral_low: ✅ Neutral/low RSI (RSI D: {rsi_daily:.1f}) : No bullish excess, acceptable entry window.
rsid.overbought: ⚠️ Daily Overbought (RSI D: {rsi_daily:.1f}) : Short-term correction risk — avoid initiating here.
vol.very_high: ⚠️ Very high volume ({rvol:.1f}x) : Potential selling pressure or institutional event — extra caution.
vol.above_avg: 📊 Above-average volume ({rvol:.1f}x) : Increased activity, watch the direction.
vol.low: 🍃 Low volume ({rvol:.1f}x) : No institutional selling pressure detected.
divrsi.bullish: 📐 Confirmed Bullish RSI Divergence : Price at a Lower Low but RSI rebounding ({rsi_creux1:.1f} → {rsi_creux2:.1f}) over the last 80 sessions — strong technical reversal signal, indicates exhaustion of selling pressure.
bb.below_lower: 📉 Below the Lower Bollinger Band (BB%: {bb_pct_val:.2f}) : extreme oversold confirmed — price outside the lower band.
bb.near_lower: 📊 Near the Lower Bollinger Band (BB%: {bb_pct_val:.2f}) : low compression, selling pressure easing.
bb.above_upper: ⚠️ Above the Upper Bollinger Band (BB%: {bb_pct_val:.2f}) : price in extreme extension, mean-reversion risk.
bb.near_upper: ⚠️ Near the Upper Bollinger Band (BB%: {bb_pct_val:.2f}) : likely short-term resistance.
macdw.bullish_cross: 🔀 Bullish Weekly MACD Cross : histogram just turned positive — momentum reversal confirmed.
macdw.positive_expanding: 📈 Positive Weekly MACD expanding ({macd_w_hist:+.3f}) : medium-term momentum accelerating.
macdw.negative_narrowing: 🔄 Negative Weekly MACD but narrowing ({macd_w_hist:+.3f}) : selling pressure decelerating.
macdw.negative_expanding: 📉 Negative Weekly MACD expanding ({macd_w_hist:+.3f}) : persistent medium-term selling pressure.
estimation.gain:
🎯 Target 1 (Return to SMA 200) : {sma200_price:.2f} ({pot_sma200_pct:+.2f}%)
   🎯 Target 2 (Return to 52w High) : {h52w_price:.2f} ({pot_52w_pct:+.2f}%)
   🛑 Reference stop (52w Floor) : {l52w_price:.2f} ({stop_pct:+.2f}%)
   📈 {c_green}{c_bold}Estimated total return (Capital + Annual div. ~{rendement_div_pct:.2f}%) : {gain_total_est_pct:+.2f}%{c_reset} (+{gain_1000e:.2f} per 1,000 invested)
expl.strong: Favorable technical confluence : {ctx}, {dist_52w_abs:.1f}% discount from the highs{div_mention}. Very favorable risk/reward.
strat.strong: Initiate a significant position (40–50% of target allocation). Add on any pullback toward support.
expl.attractive: The price is testing a key support zone{div_mention}. Attractive risk/reward, directional confirmation not yet complete.
strat.attractive: Build gradually via DCA (20–30% of target allocation). Watch for a weekly close above support.
expl.watch: Incomplete signal : insufficient discount or indicators not yet confirming a bottom.
strat.watch: Set a price alert. Wait for a pullback toward major supports (SMA 200d / SMA 50w) before acting.
expl.avoid: Deteriorated technical structure : bearish underlying trend and/or dominant negative momentum. Risk/reward is not favorable as it stands.
strat.avoid: Set aside for now. Reassess only after price stabilization and moving averages turning up.
